page.layout: One page of text in one column, with the running head "VITA" and page number "4" at the top. A footnote in smaller type stands below the text. The catchword "cum" is at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: bum sumpta sunt ex Literis Regiis
tatis illius tam Parisiis quàm in aliis Re-
que Morinus adhuc Juvenis, genus istud
dotali ordine & ad pristinum statum re-
minimè cogitans, sed quod illud esset
retque in ea Societate Presbyteros, qui
rimi faciens, illum dedit Mironio tunc
diorum illius comes esset. Is postea fa-
ejus latere vix recessit Morinus usque ad
vixit in domo Oratorii Parisiensis una cum
{b} Lettres de la Reyne Regente, An. 1612,

page.notes: The printed reference mark is "(b)" in the text and in the footnote; it is shown here as {b}. The first word "bum" is a fragment from the previous line. The text is printed with long s, which is transcribed as plain s. The catchword "cum" is printed at the right below the last line. Footnote text is partly worn at "Regente" and "An. 1612", read as printed.
